# implicitOp='&' (pattern has *T, target has T) and matched expression
# is *ptr (a deref). The & and * should cancel to give ptr directly.
ex {
	var p *S
	p.F -> NewF(p)
}
-- file.go --
package m

type S struct{ F int }

func NewF(p *S) int { return p.F + 1 }

func example(ptr *S) {
	_ = (*ptr).F
}
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 func NewF(p *S) int { return p.F + 1 }

 func example(ptr *S) {
-	_ = (*ptr).F
+	_ = NewF(ptr)
 }
